tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_prickli: Prevents damage and slowdown from cacti, berry bushes, thorns, and guardian spikes.
Locks hunger and saturation at maximum.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_water.d: Prevents drowning, normalizes walking speed in water, and provides Aqua Affinity.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_explosi: Prevents explosion damage and causes creepers to ignore you.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_falling: Prevents all fall damage, stalagmite impacts, and elytra wall collisions.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_fire.de: Prevents catching fire, extinguishes flame visuals, and nullifies lava and magma damage.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_freezin: Prevents frost damage and allows walking atop powdered snow.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_sound.d: Mutes player vibrations so sculk sensors and wardens are never triggered.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_void.de: Rescues you from falling into the void by teleporting you to the nearest safe ground.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.charm_of_eray.de: Troll Charm: Enrages neutral creatures and doubles all damage taken.
tooltip.ledgers_atelier.wings_of_an_ange: Grants creative flight while carried in your inventory.
